title: nlq-validator: Lightweight Natural Language Query Validator
description: A lightweight Natural Language Query (NLQ) validator that keeps LLM assistants on-topic. Train it on example questions and it will accept in-domain queries while rejecting off-topic ones using TF-IDF scoring or semantic embeddings. Supports incremental retraining, threshold calibration, and automatic training-data generation via Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral, Grok, and Perplexity.
